GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind Leader 2 Lengths 800m, came off fence soon after Straightening Up and did cop slight bump from Leader , chased hard the entire Straight but Just could not reel Leader in, surprised they did not fire in a protest # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered when taken wide at entrance to home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (3.5L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 200m. Chased steadily in last 150m. # Good 1st-up effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6 lengths. under pressure turn 5 lengths. Held Ground # Never Likely

Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Back 3L midrace & pushed out 3 Wide @ 700m & chasing Four Wide @ 550m. Pressured @ 400m & chasing Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Laid in @ 200m & faded in last 100m. # didn't finish off
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide with cover 4 lengths. moved up Wide turn 2 lengths. weakened # covered ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1200m was eased from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat 3-4l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, found little and kept on one pace # had run/held ground
Jumped Well , Crossed Two Wide 2nd within 1 length @ 1100m. Moved Up Took Slight Lead Soon After . Equal Lead Straightening Up Under Pressure . peaked there Just Battled # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the lead through the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 1 length. 2nd turn 2 lengths. ran on strongly late # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. got off leaders back turn 1 length. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 900m was eased from heels when racing keenly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length & Settled Down 3 Wide trailing a long head, in Two Wide by the 1150m, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormalities.] # weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Near the 350m was bumped and carried outwards. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 1.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, taken 3 Wide rounding turn and dropped right out in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormalities.] # weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Pushed fwd & led on rail by 3/4L early . Held 1/2L lead on inside midrace & held together =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pushed to quicken & challenged @ 250m. Pressured @ 200m & faded in last 100m. # Led & faded.
